status: schema only: defines fields, conventions and mappings to existing code. It carries no subsystem numbers and is not wired into abep_sim (wiring is a model change for the owner).
purpose: Common engineering ledger so that every propulsion subsystem exposes the same six quantities (performance, power, mass, rejected heat, life/degradation, uncertainty) with the same value/evidence record. Companion schemas: bus_power_ledger_v1.json (electrical source side) and thermal_rejection_ledger_v1.json (heat disposition side). Field names follow abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture where a producer exists; mapping, gaps and closure rules are in docs/ledgers/LEDGERS.md.

scope.rfp_architecture: atmospheric path: intake -> filter -> compressor -> atmospheric gas chamber -> valve; Xe path: Xe chamber -> valve; both feed ionization/discharge -> acceleration/thrust (CLAUDE.md, two-layer Hall uncertainty, Scope).
scope.boundary: the propulsion subsystem, from the intake aperture to the thruster exit plane, electrically from the propulsion DC bus input (bus_power_ledger_v1 boundary). Spacecraft bus housekeeping, solar arrays and the EPS round trip are outside (abep_sim/mission_env.py:Spacecraft, abep_sim/mission_env.py:array_area_for).
scope.not_in_scope: new propulsion families (CLAUDE.md rule 8); calibration-nuisance (layer-1) variables of the P5 experiment, which are never ledger fields, map axes or design variables.

performance.definition: subsystem-specific functional metrics at the operating point (what the subsystem delivers to the next block). Metric ids, units and producers are declared per subsystem in subsystems.<id>.performance.metrics.

power.definition: electrical power delivered to the subsystem at its load plane (converter output side). Conversion losses are booked to the ppu subsystem, never to the consumer. Bus-side totals live in bus_power_ledger_v1.

fields.P_startup_W: value_record, mode 'startup' (optional for subsystems without a startup draw: status not_applicable with reason)
fields.bus_terms: list of bus_power_ledger_v1 term ids this subsystem's load contributes to

mass.definition: current best estimate and growth by item class (abep_sim/mass_bom.py:build_bom, abep_sim/mass_bom.py:MGA).

fields.mga_class: one of mass_bom.MGA classes: new | modified | existing | calculated
fields.m_consumable_kg: value_record: propellant or other consumables carried by this subsystem (reported separately from dry mass; not_applicable if none)

rejected_heat.definition: heat that the subsystem hands to the thermal network, kept distinct from its electrical input. Full per-subsystem balance and closure rules in thermal_rejection_ledger_v1.

fields.Q_int_W: value_record: internal dissipation handed to the thermal network
fields.Q_env_absorbed_W: value_record: absorbed environmental heat (solar, Earth IR, albedo, aero) on the subsystem's external surfaces
fields.Q_rejected_W: value_record: Q_int_W + Q_env_absorbed_W (steady state; computed, never entered)
fields.P_exported_W: value_record: power leaving the subsystem to space without passing the thermal network (jet kinetic power, plume, direct plasma radiation)
fields.P_transferred_W: {target_subsystem_id: value_record}: power carried to another subsystem (e.g. flow enthalpy, source power recovered as jet power)
fields.thermal_nodes: list of abep_sim/thermal.py:default_nodes node names this subsystem's Q_int is assigned to (empty list = unassigned, which is a closure gap)

life.definition: time or cycles to the limiting degradation mechanism, with its basis, and the degradation state that feeds performance drift.

fields.limiting_mechanism: text (e.g. wall sputtering, AO coating erosion, emitter evaporation, bearing wear)
fields.degradation_metrics: {metric_id: value_record} (e.g. erosion depth, accommodation drift, B loss fraction)
fields.requirement_ref: the requirement the life is compared against (abep_sim/constants.py:RFPConstraints ignition_hours for firing basis, mission_hours for calendar basis), or TBD
fields.life_trustworthy: bool or null: true only when the producer's own validity gate is met (e.g. hall_map wall_life_trustworthy); null when the producer has no gate

uncertainty.definition: how each reported quantity is uncertain and why. Every numeric value_record carries its own evidence.uncertainty; this block lists the subsystem-level drivers and representation.

fields.drivers: list of {name, kind: epistemic | aleatory, ref: code reference of an existing prior or 'TBD — requires ...'}
fields.ensemble_member_id: transport-ensemble member id for values derived from Hall discharge outputs (hall_transport_ensemble_role carrier or downstream_consumer); null otherwise
fields.envelope_over_members: for carrier/downstream_consumer subsystems: min/max across admitted members (unweighted scenario set, no probabilities)

uncertainty_representations.triangular_prior: (low, mode, high) prior as in abep_sim/uq_modular.py:PRIORS or abep_sim/uncertainty.py:DEFAULT_PRIORS; encodes literature spread, not measurement
uncertainty_representations.distribution: any other stated distribution with its source
uncertainty_representations.unweighted_scenario_set: set of admitted alternatives reported as an envelope with no weights (the Hall layer-2 transport credible set)
uncertainty_representations.reading_variants: alternative readings of the same published evidence carried side by side (e.g. beam-efficiency readings A/B)
uncertainty_representations.none_quantified: no uncertainty stated by any source: an explicit gap, never an implicit zero

value_record.definition: every numeric quantity in a ledger instance is a value_record; bare numbers are not allowed

status_enum.computed: produced by the cited origin at the cited operating point and mode
status_enum.superseded: the only producer is a superseded or withdrawn model (e.g. the 0-D Hall closure, CLAUDE.md 'Superseded / withdrawn'); value must be null and the field must name what supersedes it
status_enum.TBD: no producer yet; value must be null and 'requires' must say what is needed
status_enum.not_applicable: the subsystem has no such quantity in this architecture or mode; value must be null and 'reason' is required

fields.value: number or null (null unless status is computed)
fields.origin: code reference 'path/to/file.py:qualname' of the producer, or 'TBD — requires <what>', or 'not_applicable — <reason>'
fields.mode: steady | peak | startup (for power and heat quantities)
fields.operating_point_ref: architecture name (abep_sim/archengine.py:arch_name) and design variables x_* of the operating point

evidence_record.definition: the attributes docs/EVIDENCE.md requires for every simulator input (its 'Future' programmatic fields)

evidence_levels.1: in-house measurement on the actual Vyovrinda hardware and operating condition
evidence_levels.2: independent measurement on the same or essentially identical hardware
evidence_levels.3: primary experimental literature on the same or closely similar hardware
evidence_levels.5: indirect published evidence (secondary literature, reviews, compilations, inherited datasets)
evidence_levels.6: engineering correlation, or extrapolation outside its directly validated domain
evidence_levels.7: assumption or hypothesis without direct validating evidence for the present application

rules: evidence level and quantity type are orthogonal (docs/EVIDENCE.md)
a code constant without a cited source is quantity_type 'assumed' at evidence level 7 until a source is recorded
a value recalled from memory without a verified source is marked 'verify' in source and cannot be above level 7
digitization, unit conversion or interpolation never changes the evidence level; it is recorded in transformation_chain

instance_required_fields.operating_point_ref: design variables and gas-path state reference
instance_required_fields.modes: list of modes evaluated (subset of steady, peak, startup)
instance_required_fields.gaps: list of gap ids from docs/ledgers/LEDGERS.md that apply to this instance

hall_transport_ensemble_roles.carrier: values are produced by an admitted transport-ensemble member's design Hall map (abep_sim/hall_map.py:HallMap); each value carries ensemble_member_id
hall_transport_ensemble_roles.downstream_consumer: values are computed from Hall discharge outputs, so they are reported per admitted member (envelope), but the subsystem's own model takes no transport parameter
hall_transport_ensemble_roles.independent: no dependence on Hall discharge outputs; must not be retuned per member (includes Vyovrinda's own geometry and B(z))
hall_transport_ensemble_roles.forbidden_upstream: upstream of the ionization/discharge block (CLAUDE.md: intake, compressor, gas chambers, valves; Xe chamber); the transport uncertainty must never leak into these models or their uncertainty drivers
hall_transport_ensemble_roles.not_applicable: archengine screening families outside the RFP Hall architecture

rules: every subsystem exposes all six quantity blocks; a block without a producer says so (status TBD with 'requires', or not_applicable with a reason); nothing is defaulted or filled with a placeholder
power is booked at the consumer's load plane; conversion losses belong to the ppu subsystem, control-electronics draw to avionics
rejected heat is never assumed equal to electrical input: Q_int_W, P_exported_W and P_transferred_W are reported separately (thermal_rejection_ledger_v1)
mass lines combined in the code (archengine 'reservoir_feed', 'accelerator', 'ppu') are reported as combined with an explicit split source, or the split is TBD; never split silently
life values declare their basis (firing_hours, calendar_hours or cycles) and are compared only with the matching requirement

no ledger value derived from the Hall discharge may be computed until an ensemble member is admitted (abep_sim/hall_ensemble.py:require_admitted); screening candidates (abep_sim/hall_ensemble.py:screening_ids) never appear in ledgers
calibration-nuisance (layer-1) variables are never ledger fields, drivers, axes or design variables
forbidden_upstream subsystems list no transport-ensemble driver and take no transport parameter
values from the superseded 0-D Hall closure are not quoted: status superseded, value null

archengine_energy_ledger_map.source: abep_sim/archengine.py:close_architecture, dict 'ledger' (residual gate |resid| <= 0.02 against loads['P_bus_W'] from abep_sim/ppu.py:PPU.loads)

jet.note: from_acc share is booked to the accelerating supply, from_src share to the source (each watt once)

neutralizer.thermal: Q_int_W at node 'cathode' is 0.5 x P_neut (abep_sim/thermal.py:default_nodes); the remainder is unassigned (gap G1)

magnets.thermal: Q_int_W at node 'magnets' (close_architecture overwrites the default_nodes value with P_mag)

aux.note: 5 V x 1 A 'aux' converter demand (5.0 W ledger code constant); the consumer is not named in the code, so its allocation between valves/flow control and avionics is TBD (gap G2)

ppu_loss_control.note: loads['P_loss_W'] lumps converter losses with controller_W + sensors_W (gap G17)
